name: Paper God: Thunder God with Two Attendants
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink on paper; with printed inscription reading from right to left: "Jiu Tian Ying Yuan Lei Shen Pu Hua Tian Zun" (Name of the Thunder God). Probably from Beijing.
